# Log11 — public documents

The website, privacy policy, terms of use and support page for the Log11 pilot
logbook for iPhone, iPad and Mac, published so the app and App Store Connect
have public addresses to point at.

| Page | URL |
|---|---|
| Home | https://aerologefb.github.io/log11-app/ |
| Privacy policy | https://aerologefb.github.io/log11-app/legal/privacy-policy/ |
| Terms of use | https://aerologefb.github.io/log11-app/legal/terms-of-use/ |
| Support | https://aerologefb.github.io/log11-app/legal/support/ |

## Do not edit the pages here

These files are copied from `site/` in the private app repository, where they
are reviewed together with the code they describe. Editing them here would let
the published text drift from what the app does.

To change them: edit `site/` in the app repository, run
`Scripts/publish-site.sh` there to copy the result into a checkout of this
repository, review the diff, then commit and push.

Contact: NAV-INT-LLC@pm.me
